checks.text: The page heading is "JSON CSV Converter".
Typing `{"name":"Alice","age":30}` in the input pane and clicking the button "Convert to CSV" shows `name,age` and `Alice,30` in the output pane.
Typing `name,age` and `Alice,30` in the input pane and clicking the button "Convert to JSON" shows `{"name":"Alice","age":30}` in the output pane.
After converting `{"name":"Alice","age":30}` to CSV, clicking the button "Copy output" places the text `name,age` and `Alice,30` on the clipboard.
After converting `{"name":"Alice","age":30}` to CSV, clicking the button "Download" saves a file named `output.csv` containing `name,age` and `Alice,30`.

With the input `{"name":"Alice","age":30}` converted to CSV, selecting "Semicolon" in the setting labelled "Delimiter" and clicking "Convert to CSV" shows `name;age` and `Alice;30` in the output pane.
After converting `{"name":"Alice","age":30}` to CSV, the history list contains an entry labelled "JSON to CSV". Clicking the button "Clear history" removes all entries from the history list.

Typing `name,age` and `Alice,30` in the input pane and clicking the button "Convert to JSON" shows `{"name":"Alice","age":30}` in the output pane; clicking the button "Swap" moves that JSON text to the input pane and the CSV text to the output pane.
Reload keeps the history entry labelled "JSON to CSV" and the setting "Delimiter" set to "Semicolon".
